stories.title: ICE agent shoots and wounds man in Austin, Texas

en.title: ICE agent shoots and wounds man in Austin, Texas
en.summary: An ICE agent shot a 28-year-old Venezuelan national in Austin, Texas. The man was struck at least once in the torso and was reported in serious but stable condition.

en.title: Patrick Clancy Describes Grief in First Interview Since Mistrial
en.summary: Patrick Clancy discussed his grief in a television interview following a mistrial. His three children were killed by their mother in 2023.

en.title: After Pursuit, ICE Agent Shoots Venezuelan Immigrant in Austin
en.summary: An ICE agent shot a Venezuelan immigrant in Austin during a pursuit. The shooting reflects intensified deportation enforcement under the Trump administration.

en.title: Patrick Clancy talks about grief, forgiveness and the future with '60 Minutes' after Lindsay Clancy mistrial
en.summary: Patrick Clancy gave his first interview after his ex-wife's mistrial, discussing his grief over losing his three children in Massachusetts. He reflected on his efforts before the tragic killings.

en.summary: A federal immigration agent shot and injured a man in Austin, Texas. The person was reported in serious but stable condition by the city mayor.
